name: Apple Music

http.reason: Apple Music 目录搜索（Bearer developer token）

description: Resolves artists to Apple Music catalog IDs by searching the catalog (`/v1/catalog/{storefront}/search`), so artists can link back to Apple Music. Requires a developer token (a MusicKit ES256 JWT); the storefront defaults to `us`. Use "Test connection" to verify the token and storefront before scraping.
author: TMA

en.description: Resolves artists to Apple Music catalog IDs by searching the catalog (`/v1/catalog/{storefront}/search`), so artists can link back to Apple Music. Requires a developer token (a MusicKit ES256 JWT); the storefront defaults to `us`. Use "Test connection" to verify the token and storefront before scraping.
en.config.developer_token.title: Developer token
en.config.developer_token.description: MusicKit developer token (ES256 JWT) generated for your Apple developer team.
en.config.storefront.title: Storefront
en.config.storefront.description: ISO country code of the catalog to search (e.g. us, jp); defaults to us.
en.actions.test_connection.label: Test connection
